notes: All six searches ran; none was refused. One search-engine summary said his campaign material describes him as trained in AI and a 'Certified AI Consultant'; I could not find this on any page I opened, so it is unverified, and in any case it is a career credential, not a statement about AI risk. No source shows him sponsoring the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (he is not yet a member) or signing any AI letter.
